messages:
alana: FYI we had a single OOM in prod-runtime-07 last night during a heavy compaction window. Root trace looked like allocator pins during compaction. Starting this thread to convert postmortem TODOs into tracked actions and owners.

mira: Thanks. From the postmortem: short-term mitigations (feature-flag compaction concurrency cap + abort threshold), medium-term RCA (heapshots + jemalloc stats), and telemetry to detect recurrence.

devon: I can produce a reproducible miniworkload and capture heap profiles. I noticed live-set growth after repeated compactions in local runs. Will instrument compact start/stop and live-pages per shard. PR to follow.

kai: I'll implement the feature-flagged soft cap and an instant abort when host free < 10%. Plan: dark-launch collecting metrics only, then canary 1% traffic. ETA: 24h to dark launch.

sre-bot: Ticket INF-3250 created: "runtime: intermittent OOMs during compaction" assigned to mira, devon, kai. Priority P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3250

alana: Owners and due dates:
- Kai: soft cap + abort flag rollout / due 24h
- Devon: instrumentation + repro harness / due 48h
- Mira: profiling plan + backfill telemetry / due 5d
- Alana: coordinate canary and capacity / due 24h

devon: Commands I'm using for profiling:
```
./run_repro --qps 40 --duration 60m --trace compact --heap-profiler=sampling
scripts/collect_flame.sh --target prod-like --out /tmp/compact_flame.svg
```

mira: I'll backfill metrics: kv.compact.count, kv.compact.concurrent, kv.compact.abort_count, kv.live_pages.p95 for 90 days. Also check recent changes to compaction heuristics and allocator upgrades.

kai: Dark-launch plan: flag-only for 12h, verify metrics and no behavioral change, then canary 2 hosts with abort enabled for 24h. Rollback: flip flag off + drain in-flight compactions.

alana: Add a temporary alert: fire when compaction.abort_count > 3 in 10m or host free < 8% during compaction.

devon: Status update: instrumentation PR opened, waiting review from @mira. Need permission to run longer repro on staging (quota).

kai: Status update: flag branch pushed, unit tests green, will enable dark metrics in 6h.

mira: Status update: profiling plan posted and scheduled; starting data collection tonight. Blocker: need consistent shard->host mapping in logs; @alana can you add tags?

alana: Will add shard_id to compaction logs and correlate host ids. ETA 6h.

sre-bot: Backfill job scheduled: backfill-metrics-2025-03-05 for kv.compact.* and kv.live_pages.*

alana: Action: schedule cross-team demo of initial RCA findings (owners: mira + devon). Target date: 2025-01-22.

mira: If RCA points to allocator behavior, we may need to consider short-term jemalloc config tweaks or an allocator rollback. Keep that in mind for remediation planning.

alana: Keep daily one-line updates here until INF-3250 closed. If urgent, ping me directly.

(End)
